pages.text: This violet-and-black vessel seems to ignore ordinary confinement. Its aether never runs dry, supplying jars and adjacent devices.

pages.title: A creator's vessel
pages.text: Obtain it from the creative inventory; it has no crafting recipe. Its throughput still limits delivery. Wireless branches still need Amethyst Shards and connected paths.$(br2)This guide records common readings. Worlds may follow different rhythms; trust the readings shown by your actual devices.
